content.title: Weekly research intake — 2026-11-27 — end-to-end rehearsal and ASU follow-up
content.body:
<!-- degreesteps-research-intake:v1 -->

## End-to-end rehearsal — real research, no invented policies
This submission is a labeled simulation of the Friday workflow requested by the owner. The ASU follow-up is a real student question and must be independently researched. Implement only supported improvements using the current architecture, write substantive SEO content, run tests, open a PR and follow the approved release workflow. A simulation is not academic approval or permission to bypass production gates. Preserve student records, historical awards and existing receiving-school mappings.

## P1
- [ ] Verify ASU Universal Learner upfront versus transcript-posting payments, grade and purchase deadlines, eligibility and minimum pacing; improve the source profile and create a substantive ASU Universal Learner versus Sophia comparison only if it adds a useful new student decision beyond existing content. https://ea.asu.edu/how-it-works/pricing/ https://ea.asu.edu/help-center/faqs/ https://www.sophia.org/plans-and-pricing/

## P0
- [ ] Verify Google ACE renewal windows for GOOG-0009, GOOG-0007, GOOG-0008 (reported Nov 30 expiry); preserve valid historical awards. https://www.acenet.edu/National-Guide/

## Rejection control
- [ ] Test the unsupported inference that university-issued credit or a provider partnership guarantees acceptance into every degree. Reject the inference without exact receiving-school evidence; create no new receiving awards or readiness promotions. https://ea.asu.edu/help-center/faqs/

Record receipt hashes, scoped verification, product paths, content metadata/citations, replay results, PR and release receipts. The repeated Google lead should reuse existing findings and reviews; it must not create duplicate work or erase history.
